proposal.reason: Main change is in NET transport/proxy behavior: default TX send-credit head storage moves to sender-local device memory with explicit mapping/open/close and initialization in send connect/free paths. Include transport because this adds allocation-only P2P proxy connection APIs/ownership flow used to provision and tear down those head buffers. Include memory because allocator semantics add MEM_LEGACY runtime device allocation/free and explicitly bypass mem-manager untrack for that mode, changing memory-ownership/tracking behavior.
